description_en:
Creates or updates scheduling settings.
Release version: v5.4.2
description_zh:
新建或者修改调度设置。
上线版本：v5.4.2
name: UpsertQualitySchedule

fields.help_en: The ID of the schedule resource. If specified, the operation updates the existing resource. If not specified, the operation creates a new resource
fields.help_zh: 调度对象ID: 传递代表更新,不传递代表新建
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The ID of the monitored object
fields.name: watch_id

fields.help_en: The name of the schedule resource
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The scheduling type. Valid values:
PERIOD_SCHEDULE: timed scheduling.
MANUAL_SCHEDULE: manual trigger.
CODE_CHECK_TRIGGER: code check trigger.
STATIC_TASK_TRIGGER: fixed task trigger.
DEPENDENCY_SCHEDULE: dependency scheduling
fields.help_zh: 调度类型: PERIOD_SCHEDULE 定时调度、MANUAL_SCHEDULE 手动触发、CODE_CHECK_TRIGGER 代码检查触发、STATIC_TASK_TRIGGER 固定任务触发、DEPENDENCY_SCHEDULE 依赖调度
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The partition type. Valid values:
EVERY_DAY: every day.
PRE_DAY: previous day.
TODAY: current day.
FIRST_DAY_OF_WEEK: first day of the week (Sunday).
CUSTOM: custom
fields.help_zh: 分区类型: EVERY_DAY 每天、PRE_DAY 昨天、TODAY 当天、FIRST_DAY_OF_WEEK 每周第一天(周日)、CUSTOM 自定义等
fields.name: partition_type

fields.help_en: The partition expression for custom expressions
fields.help_zh: 分区表达式-自定义表达式
fields.name: partition_expression

fields.help_en: The checklist of trigger nodes for trigger scheduling
fields.help_zh: 触发调度-触发任务清单
fields.name: trigger_node_list

fields.help_en:
The trigger method for fixed task triggers. Valid values:
ALL_TASKS_FINISHED
ONE_TASKS_FINISHED
PRE_ONE_TASKS_START
fields.help_zh: 固定任务触发-触发方式: ALL_TASKS_FINISHED、ONE_TASKS_FINISHED、PRE_ONE_TASKS_START
fields.name: static_task_trigger_type

fields.help_en:
The trigger method for trigger scheduling. Valid values:
STATIC_TASK_TRIGGER: fixed task trigger.
CODE_CHECK_TRIGGER: code check trigger
fields.help_zh: 触发调度-触发方式：STATIC_TASK_TRIGGER 固定任务触发、CODE_CHECK_TRIGGER 代码检查触发
fields.name: trigger_type

fields.help_en:
The scheduling interval type for timed scheduling. Valid values:
DAILY: day.
WEEKLY: week.
MONTHLY: month.
HOURLY: hour.
MINUTELY: minute
fields.help_zh: 定时调度-调度周期类型: DAILY 天、WEEKLY 周、MONTHLY 月、HOURLY 小时、MINUTELY 分钟
fields.name: period_schedule_interval_type

fields.help_en: The scheduling interval values for timed scheduling
fields.name: period_schedule_param_list

fields.help_en: The cron expression for timed scheduling
fields.name: cron_expression

fields.help_en:
The validation scope. Valid values:
TASK_REFERRED_PARTITION: task update partition.
USER_DEFINED_PARTITION: custom partition
fields.help_zh: 校验范围: TASK_REFERRED_PARTITION 任务更新分区,USER_DEFINED_PARTITION 自定义分区
fields.name: validate_partition_type
